# modify-existing-app
Me caveman. Me modify-existing-app skill. Me do one thing and keep contract short.

## Purpose

Sylvain is not only a scaffolder. This skill carries the contract for **safe modification** of an existing app: it detects what already exists, plans the minimal incremental change, and routes to the right specialised skills.

## Inputs

- The user's change description (free text, mandatory).
- The workspace root of the existing app.

## Pre-checks (read-only)

1. Confirm the project was generated by sylvain-builder (presence of `.sylvain/` folder or matching `pom.xml` / `package.json` markers).
2. Read `.sylvain/compatibility-matrix.json`. If any version drifted, suggest running `suggest-latest-stack` first; do not silently upgrade.
3. Run `enforce-file-size-limit` and `enforce-documentation` on the touched modules; record baseline.
4. Run `audit-pom-dependencies` and `audit-npm-dependencies`. Block on HIGH/CRITICAL CVE before any change.
5. Persist a new task to `.sylvain/todo.json` via `manage-task-todo` with a numbered checklist.

## Planning contract

Produce a one-page plan containing:
- the affected layers (backend module / REST endpoint / JPA entity / React screen / hook / OpenAPI types);
- the specialised skills to invoke, in order;
- the impact on the public OpenAPI contract;
- a rollback note (which files would be reverted on failure);
- a test plan for the backend layer (frontend stays test-free per kit policy).

The plan is written into `todo.json` before any file is written.

## Execution contract

- Each generated or modified file stays ≤ 100 lines (split modules if needed).
- Every public Java class/method gets Javadoc; every exported TS symbol gets TSDoc.
- Backend changes always trigger `generate-junit-test` and, when persistence/HTTP is touched, `generate-integration-test`.
- Frontend changes never produce `*.test.ts(x)` files. Compiler-friendly idioms only (no manual memoisation).
- After every increment, `progressive-build-verify` runs: backend `mvn -q verify`, frontend `pnpm run lint && pnpm run build`.
- Before committing, `scan-source-vulnerabilities` and `validate-java25-idioms` / `validate-react19-idioms` must pass.

## Invariants

- Never bump a locked version without an ADR (write to `.sylvain/architecture-decisions.md`).
- Never introduce a new top-level dependency without checking it via `audit-pom-dependencies` / `audit-npm-dependencies` first.
- Never delete user data, migrations, or ADR entries.
- The OpenAPI spec is the single source of truth — regenerate TS types via `generate-typescript-types` when the backend contract changes.
- Reply in the developer's language.

## Failure handling

- If a build or test fails after a change, surface the exact failure, propose one minimal fix, and **stop** (do not retry blindly).
- If a CVE appears mid-task, route to `security-guardian` and pause the todo.

## Routing matrix

| Intent                              | Skill                          |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| New REST endpoint                   | `generate-rest-endpoint`       |
| New persistent aggregate            | `generate-jpa-entity`          |
| New AI feature (chat, RAG, tool)    | `generate-spring-ai-feature`   |
| New backend module                  | `generate-spring-boot-module`  |
| New screen                          | `generate-react-screen`        |
| Reusable stateful logic             | `generate-react-hook`          |
| Backend contract changed            | `generate-typescript-types`    |
| Bump dependencies                   | `suggest-latest-stack`         |

## Done criteria

- Plan resolved (todo.json all ✅).
- Build green, tests green, no HIGH+ CVE, no doc/size violation.
- ADR appended if any locked version moved.
- Conventional Commit message proposed (one PR = one subject).
